LanguageData.VerbalCommands_DevModeNotice_Title: Verbal Commands: dev mode changes the voice toggle key
LanguageData.VerbalCommands_DevModeNotice_Body:
Dev mode is on, so ~ (BackQuote) opens the debug log and no longer toggles voice dictation.

In dev mode, the voice toggle is {0} by default.

Both keys can be changed in Options > Mod settings > Verbal Commands.
